rows: Addendum (frames in `clis/cdp`): the harness-facing helpers on top of the frame layer. `find_frame_named` (the harness names its app frame `device-frame-app`; waits up to a timeout, as `findDeviceFrame` does for 10 s), `find_editable_frame(root, depth)` (depth first through the descendants of a frame for a contenteditable or textarea, as `findEditableFrame`), `device_frame_url` (the harness URL with `URLSearchParams` encoding: spaces as `+`, UTF-8 percent-encoded) and `fitted_shell_size` (box plus the 24 px margin and 40 px label allowance, each rounded up to an even number; the arithmetic was checked against `fittedShellSize` by hand and a first wrong expectation of mine was corrected). `clis/cdp/tests/attached.rs` is 14 tests, 14/14 on two consecutive runs against a real Chromium. Next: launching a Chromium with the device-emulation flags and creating a device-frame session in the Rust daemon.
